sources.name: Stitch - A guide to South African payment rails

entries.subject: gotyme_kiosk_channel
entries.display: GoTyme Bank runs account management through the app and physical kiosks, not internet banking
entries.quote: we're moving all your account management into the GoTyme Bank app and kiosks. Internet banking is no longer available.
entries.notes: The page also carries a Kiosk Locator, i.e. kiosks are a physical channel; the capture does not name the host retailers. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: ewallet_agencyplus_withdrawal
entries.display: FNB eWallet cash can be withdrawn at an FNB ATM, AgencyPlus agent or a shop
entries.quote: Select 'At ATM or AgencyPlus' or 'At Shop' and tap Continue
entries.notes: WhatsApp Get Cash flow. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: ewallet_retail_acceptance
entries.display: eWallet can be spent at selected petrol station forecourts and convenience stores
entries.quote: Make a purchase at selected Engen, Shell, Sasol, and TotalEnergies fuel stations
entries.notes: Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: supermarket_till_withdrawal_fee
entries.display: R2.00 to withdraw cash at a South African supermarket tillpoint
entries.notes: Retail tillpoint as a cash-out channel for Capitec clients.

entries.subject: supermarket_till_deposit_fee
entries.display: R1.40 per R100 deposited in notes and coins at a supermarket tillpoint
entries.quote: | South African supermarket tillpoint (notes and coins) | 1.40 per 100.00 |
entries.notes: Cash-in at a retail till; value is the fee per R100 deposited.

entries.subject: voucher_cash_in_points
entries.display: Vouchers let unbanked customers turn cash into digital value at supermarkets and petrol stations
entries.quote: Customers exchange cash for vouchers in a physical retail location, such as a supermarket or petrol station
entries.notes: Industry explainer; describes the retail agent model for cash-in.

entries.subject: cash_at_till_channel
entries.display: Cash at ATM / cash at till lets a customer pay online then settle in cash at an ATM or branch
entries.quote: Customers choose “Cash at ATM” or “Cash at till” when checking out online

notes: The Post Office page captured in this corpus is postal-only (stamps, parcel tracking, PAMSS) and states no banking agency service, so no Post Office or PostBank agent fact is asserted. Agent-channel facts come from GoTyme's kiosk model, FNB's AgencyPlus/retail withdrawal network, Capitec's supermarket tillpoint pricing, and Stitch's description of voucher and cash-at-till cash-in. The 18-payment-system count from SARB belongs to regulations and is deliberately not duplicated here.
